query: Consider the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement between Mutual Customer and Allazo Electronics; Does the document permit the Receiving Party to retain some Confidential Information even after its return or destruction?
gold: Within ten (10) days after any written request by the Disclosing Party, the Receiving Party shall promptly return all copies of the Confidential Information.
rag_answer: No. Under the provided document, Section 9 requires the Receiving Party to “promptly return all copies of the Confidential Information” within ten days after a written request, and it does not contain any exception permitting the Receiving Party to retain Confidential Information after return or destruction.

judge.gold_summary: 收到披露方书面请求后十(10)日内，接收方应迅速返还保密信息的全部副本。
judge.answer_summary: 回答称第9条要求在书面请求后十天内迅速返还保密信息的全部副本，且没有允许接收方在返还或销毁后保留保密信息的例外。
judge.reason: 系统回答覆盖了金标的关键要点：接收方需在书面请求后十天内返还全部保密信息副本，并据此否定可保留信息的情形。
